Anchored In Excellence, Driven by Compassion

Emergency
Our team is available, so you always have somewhere to turn in a critical moment.
Internal Medicine
At WAVES, our Internal Medicine team is here to solve the cases that aren’t always straightforward.
Medical Oncology
Advanced cancer care to improve your pet’s comfort, quality of life, & treatment outcomes.
Radiation oncology
Precision radiation therapy designed to target cancer while prioritizing your pet’s comfort and quality of life.
Surgery
Specialized care for pets requiring everything from urgent procedures to complex operations.
We’re changing the narrative.
At WAVES, we pride ourselves on being more than doctors. We’re your partners. We serve a connected community of pet parents and veterinary professionals who believe that the highest level of medicine is delivered with both clinical excellence and genuine human connection.
This is not a relationship that begins and ends with a single visit. It’s a lasting partnership built over years of shared trust and care.
Our Story
Our team
Excellence in Care
We are partners in care. We foster a culture rooted in intentional kindness, clear communication, and expertise delivered with respect and humility. Our team is inclusive, supportive, and united by a shared purpose.
Our People
Compassion
We treat every client, patient, and teammate with professionalism, empathy, and care. Especially in the most stressful and emotional moments. We honor the human-animal bond in everything we do.
Teamwork
We show up for each other, take ownership of our work, and follow through. We operate as one cohesive team; always learning, improving, and supporting one another to do better for every patient.
Medical Excellence
We are committed to advanced, consistent, and thoughtful medicine. We hold ourselves to a high clinical standard and continuously strive to deliver the best possible outcomes.
Emergency Care
Emergency and critical care for pets when it matters most. Our experienced emergency team is equipped to manage urgent, life-threatening conditions as well as complex cases requiring advanced hospitalization.
Honest Communication
We communicate with clarity, honesty, and intention so pet parents and veterinary partners can make informed, confident decisions. No ambiguity. Just transparency and trust.
Tour our clinic
With continuous monitoring, including overnight and post-operative care. Your pet is supported every step of the way by a team you can trust.
Our Story
Great medicine is only as good as the heart behind it.
Locally owned and veterinarian-led, WAVES is defined by medical excellence and integrity, with every clinical decision guided by what is in the patient’s best interests.
